data.name: Mubashshirah
data.gender_notes: Mubashshirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'bashshir', which means 'to bring good news'. The name Mubashshirah carries the meaning “Bringer of Good News” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubashshirah usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Mubashshirah signifies the conveyance of blessings and happiness.
data.etymology: Mubashshirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubashshirah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مبشرَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: المبشرَة: فعل مبشر، مفعول مبشر، يُبصرُهُ اللَّهُ بِالسَّلام، وَيُبَشِرُهُ بِالخَيْر، فَهُوَ المُبَشَّرُ بِالنَجاح، وَالخَيْرُ هُوَ النَجاحُ

in_urdu.name: مبشرہ
in_urdu.meaning: خوشخبری دینے والی، خوشی لانے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبشرہ: یہ نام عرب کے لفظ مبشر سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوشخبری دینے والی، خوشی لانے والی، یہ نام مسلمانوں میں بڑی مقبولیت رکھتا ہے کہیں یہ نام خواتین کے لیے بہت اچھا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुबश्शिराह
in_hindi.meaning: खुशखबरी देने वाली, खुशी देने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबश्शिराह: यह नाम अरबी के शब्द मुबश्शिर से मिलता-जुलता है जिसका अर्थ है खुशखबरी देने वाली, खुशी देने वाली, इस नाम का उपयोग मुस्लिम समुदाय में किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: مبشره

in_english.name: Mubashshirah
in_english.meaning: bearer of good news, bringer of happiness
